test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trolleys are baskets.

Some briefcase are trolleys.

**Conclusions:**

I. All briefcase are baskets.

II. Some basket are briefcases.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
As per the given statements, the least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3ae79a9d57ede273857eb29c7c0a48731c37d8c9d161c13039977c067dc19e6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ee36cce13beb172974b3289aa66f9af4e883f5a06795d44765aa003ce5644e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All briefcases are baskets. → N**ot follow** (All trolleys are baskets, and some briefcases are trolleys. which means only some briefcases are baskets)

II. Some baskets are briefcases. →** Follow** (All trolleys are baskets, and some briefcases are trolleys, which means some baskets are briefcases)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
